scope: P10 independent public-source editorial curation of installation-local subjects for engineering and cultural-research only.
status: Final editorial choices pending P2 review; NOT an activated or accepted registry. No IDs allocated. No executable or governance approval.

sourceBoundary.excluded: No hidden S4, private or heldout sources, runtime outputs, retrieval ranks, source judgments or executable registry consulted.

semantics.identity: Each key resolves only inside its installation. Repeated keys across installations do not merge identities or transfer aliases.
semantics.parent: Editorial topic containment; every child inherits only the locally defined broader topic. It is not object subtype, causal warrant, approval standing or applicability. Intermediate nodes are warranted by the actual cited descendant passages, not merely by proposed hierarchy metadata.
semantics.association: Each related edge is authored once as a symmetric association. Its inverse is derived, never separately authored. Association entails neither ancestry nor a tested joint claim.
semantics.aliases: Only source-evidenced aliases are authored. Context is required when spellings collide; casing alone is insufficient to disambiguate Éclat/éclat or Rouge. Locale is supplied only where the source establishes language.
semantics.classifications: This file defines vocabulary only; it does not author or change record assignments. All draft omitted assignments remain absent, especially the source-explicitly missing keyboard-capture classification. Citing a passage as vocabulary warrant does not assign a record to that vocabulary.

definition.text: Local topic for the engineering of software behavior and interfaces represented by Aurora contracts, proposals, audits and tests.
includes: Engineering tests and historical implementation behavior
excludes: Claims about all engineering disciplines
Automatic approval of described proposals

subjects.label: Software engineering

definition.text: Engineering topics concerning software components, their user interfaces and data conversion behavior.
excludes: Non-software engineering
Unspecified release-announcement emphasis

subjects.parentRationale: Software components are a narrower engineering topic; exporter and interface passages ground the local specialization.

subjects.label: Frontend interfaces

definition.text: User-facing software presentation and interaction in the local web, desktop and Android interface material.
excludes: Backend services without interface relevance
A claim that all design systems are frontend-only

subjects.parentRationale: User-facing presentation and interaction specialize the local software topic across the named platforms.

subjects.label: Frontend design systems

definition.text: Local subject restricted to reusable frontend interface conventions and their named design values in the Aurora material.
excludes: Enterprise design governance
Brand strategy and non-interface assets
Design-system work outside frontend interfaces

subjects.parentRationale: The local definition deliberately narrows this otherwise broad term to reusable frontend interface conventions, so inherited frontend membership is warranted.

subjects.label: Design tokens

definition.text: Named reusable values used to express local frontend interface design properties.
includes: Token values and roles documented by the glossary
excludes: Every color value regardless of token identity
Serialization processes considered independently of tokens
Animation cues solely because they have names

subjects.parentRationale: Named reusable interface design values are a contained design-system topic; this does not assert that a token object is itself a whole design system.

subjects.label: Color tokens

definition.text: Design-token topics concerning named interface colors and their alpha values.
excludes: Accent role as a subtype of token
Every color serialization operation
The spark-start animation cue

subjects.parentRationale: Color-valued design tokens specialize the named design-value topic. The serialization branch is independent.

subjects.label: Color serialization

definition.text: Software processes and contracts for representing color values in an output notation while handling alpha and color-space information.
excludes: A kind of color-token object
Image-viewer P3 acceptance as proof of exporter behavior
Automatic equivalence between proposals and active contracts

subjects.parentRationale: Representing color data is a software operation, separately warranted from the design-token object branch.

subjects.label: CSS color serialization

definition.text: Color-serialization behavior and proposals specifically for CSS exporter output.
excludes: Android image-viewer support inferred to qualify an Android CSS exporter
Color-role naming without a serialization claim

subjects.parentRationale: CSS output is a format and exporter specialization of color representation processes, not a narrower color-token object.

subjects.label: Card layout

definition.text: Frontend design-system topics concerning card geometry, including corner radius.
excludes: Preview values generalized to production
Unmentioned card dimensions or spacing

subjects.parentRationale: Card geometry conventions are part of the locally narrowed frontend interface design-system topic.

subjects.label: Release styling

definition.text: Frontend design-system styling conventions differentiated by release or delivery channel.
excludes: General release operations without a styling topic
Preview styling treated as production replacement

subjects.parentRationale: Channel-specific interface styling specializes reusable frontend design conventions; this does not collapse release responsibility into layout.

subjects.label: Interface animation

definition.text: Software-interface animation topics, including proposed named motion cues.
includes: The proposed Android animation cue spark-start
excludes: The accent-color role named éclat
An approved production animation contract inferred from a draft

subjects.parentRationale: The Android animation proposal concerns interface presentation and thus falls within the local frontend topic.

subjects.label: Image viewer

definition.text: User-facing image-viewer capabilities and associated image or screenshot limits in the Android material.
excludes: An Android CSS export qualification
Web 4 focus-ring requirements

subjects.parentRationale: Image display and capture behavior are user-facing software presentation topics; no unrelated exporter claim is inherited.

coverage: Defines every assigned subject key in the public proposal, plus explicitly warranted intermediate topics. No source-explicit missing classification is filled; no IDs, approval, lifecycle or scope values are allocated or normalized.
